rows.title: "car or bike" takes either
rows.defect: an either-or gear line needs both words
rows.test: a driver with a car fits delivery

rows.title: Best rate first
rows.defect: the fits are sorted lowest rate first
rows.test: rideshare before delivery

rows.title: Unpaid time comes off
rows.defect: unpaid time is ignored
rows.test: 15 unpaid minutes an hour take a fifth off

rows.title: Nothing fits, said whole
rows.defect: an empty list is written into the sentence (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: no work fits reads as a sentence

rows.title: "tx" is Texas
rows.defect: the state must match in capitals (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a lower-case state meets a TX-only bonus

rows.title: The new-customer clock starts at closing
rows.defect: the clock starts when the old account opened
rows.test: an account closed 364 days ago still counts

rows.title: Deposits over the window
rows.defect: one month's pay must cover the window's total (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: $3,000 a month meets $5,000 within 60 days

rows.title: A 365-day year
rows.defect: interest is figured on a 360-day year
rows.test: $15,000 for 90 days at 4 percent forgoes $147.95

rows.title: Landed means a credit
rows.defect: debits count as landed portal money
rows.test: a Rakuten purchase is not a payout

rows.title: Only a portal's own credit has landed
rows.defect: any credit worded cashback or cash back counts as portal money (the bug fixed after merge)
rows.test: a card's cash-back credits are not portal money

rows.title: Expired offers are gone
rows.defect: the expiry is not checked
rows.test: yesterday's $30.00 offer is left out

rows.title: An offer expiring today still counts
rows.defect: the expiry day is dropped
rows.test: o4 expiring Oct 12 is on the list

rows.title: Already activated is done
rows.defect: an activated offer is staged again
rows.test: an activated offer stages nothing

rows.title: A request, never an execution
rows.defect: the request is widened to execute itself
rows.test: the request has exactly its six fields

rows.title: One end of a window still bounds it
rows.defect: a window with one end is open forever (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a category that ended Sep 30 is 1 percent in October

rows.title: The cap left, then the base rate
rows.defect: the bonus rate is paid on the whole purchase (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: $1,000 with $200 of cap left is $18.00

rows.title: Activation named
rows.defect: a merchant offer is named by its missing category (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "5 percent on Mock Shoes needs activating first"

rows.title: Frozen cards are left out
rows.defect: only closed cards are left out
rows.test: a frozen 9 percent card is not suggested

rows.title: Zero is zero
rows.defect: a 0 base rate becomes 1 percent (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a card earning nothing is 0 percent

rows.title: The foreign fee comes off abroad
rows.defect: the foreign fee is not netted
rows.test: Mock Blue nets $0.00 abroad

rows.title: The disputed amount is positive
rows.defect: the charge's sign is kept, so it reads -$89.99
rows.test: the dispute is for $89.99

rows.title: Asked in words
rows.defect: the raw field names are asked for (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "I need what happened and the date"

rows.title: Follow up in two weeks
rows.defect: the follow-up is ten days out
rows.test: the follow-up is Oct 26 for a letter on Oct 12

rows.title: No usage, no price
rows.defect: plans are priced on zero kWh (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: an empty usage list asks for a month of kWh

rows.title: A missing month is not zero
rows.defect: a month with no reading counts as 0 kWh (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: three months with one blank make 12,000 kWh a year

rows.title: No deposit means none
rows.defect: 0 months becomes one month's rent (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: deposit_months 0 adds no deposit line

rows.title: Plain decimals
rows.defect: tiny quantities are written in exponent form (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: A trade needs a basis too
rows.defect: only sales are checked for a basis
rows.test: the SOL trade is listed as missing a basis

rows.title: The window's last day counts
rows.defect: the last day of the window is left out
rows.test: a bill due in 30 days is listed

rows.title: Past bills are not coming up
rows.defect: past due dates are listed
rows.test: a bill due yesterday is not listed

rows.title: One bill, singular
rows.defect: one bill is written in the plural (the words bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "1 bill ... 1 needs a manual payment"

rows.title: The calendar's as-of
rows.defect: the bill calendar drops its as-of
rows.test: the bill calendar says today as its as-of

rows.title: The best card's as-of
rows.defect: the card pick drops its as-of
rows.test: the card pick says today as its as-of

rows.title: An expired offer is not staged
rows.defect: the expiry is not checked before staging (the bug fixed after merge)
rows.test: yesterday's offer is refused, nothing staged

rows.title: No date, no staging
rows.defect: an offer is staged when there is no date to check its expiry against
rows.test: with an expiry and no date it asks for today

rows.title: One bill, listed once
rows.defect: a named bill and its recurring row are both listed (the bug fixed after merge)
rows.test: the power bill named and recurring is one line

rows.title: The same bill is close in time
rows.defect: any named bill with the same name absorbs the recurring row, whatever the date
rows.test: a named bill 15 days from the recurring one stays separate
